item.description:
Bounded by pristine bushland on five acres of premium, fully-usable land, this sublime estate delivers the ultimate resort-style equine sanctuary just moments from schools, village shopping, marinas and beaches. Architect-designed and recently renovated to the highest standard, it showcases leafy filtered vistas stretching to the ocean, two expansive living and dining zones, a sophisticated marble island kitchen, and a sumptuous master suite, all flowing seamlessly to terraces, courtyards and a spectacular entertainers' terrace that steps down to a sparkling heated pool. Completely hidden from the street amid rolling lawns peppered with landscaped tropical and native gardens, the property features an Olympic-size jumps arena, superb stable facilities for six horses and two post-and-rail paddocks. Fully fenced with two separate access driveways and no adjoining neighbours, it rests less than 10 minutes from Mona Vale village, schools and beaches, and only 40 minutes from the Sydney CBD.

Accommodation Features:

•	A grand statement entrance foyer welcomes guests
•	Pavilion-style glass embraced design with two wings 
•	Views over the grounds to sparkling ocean horizons
•	Palatial living area with soaring ceiling and views
•	Vast family/meals with an open marble fireplace
•	Integrated marble island kitchen with walk-in pantry
•	Smeg gas cooking, integrated dishwasher and fridge
•	Indulgent main bedroom, walk-in robe and ensuite
•	Oversized bedrooms with built-ins, guest with ensuite
•	Home office with built-in timer desk and cabinetry
•	Designer bathrooms, marble vanities/feature walls
•	High raked ceilings and engineered timber floors
•	Ducted/split-system air-con and louvred windows 
•	Glass sliding doors open to private alfresco areas 

External Features:

•	Automatic secure gated access via keypad/intercom 
•	A long driveway winds around to the residence
•	Two waterfalls with ponds sit by the front portico
•	Covered ocean-view entertainers' terrace with BBQ
•	Sparkling heated pool framed by a sunlit terrace 
•	Near level side lawn with fire-pit area and views
•	Recently cleared and landscaped gardens 
•	Porte cochere or double carport by house entry 
•	Secure visitor parking for seven or more cars
•	Covered stone arched machinery storage shelter
•	Newly renovated stable includes a powder room 
•	Six horse stalls, feed and tack rooms, wash bay
•	High clearance machinery shed and hay loft
•	Premium Olympic-size jumps area
•	Two paddocks/shelters, rolling lawns for galloping
•	Private second driveway to the equestrian facilities
•	Additional street access from Minkara Road
•	Double garage with an adjoining workshop

Location Benefits:

•	Whisper-quiet and teeming with native wildlife 
•	Set right on the border of Bayview
•	2.7km to Bayview Golf Course
•	2.7km to Mona Vale Public School
•	2.8km to Pittwater High School
•	2.8km to Mona Vale Village
•	2.45km to St Luke's Grammar Bayview Campus
•	2.97m to Bayview Wharf and Gibson Marina 
•	3.6km to Monash Golf Course
•	3.7km to Mona Vale Beach 
•	5.4km to Elanora Country Club
•	Short drive to Whale Beach and Palm Beach
